answer: Walk the trail by hand: it is short enough to walk and long enough to trip a farm. Curing a proof takes 10 days, and a farm holding 127 proofs cannot cure them side by side. The record only grows longer, and a mask that turns up twice is caught by its own echo. A ridge can be painted, a haven can be borrowed, but a juniper must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. The strongest wall I know is Wine gauger dry sherry proof racked in the tasting parlour, and it is built out of each dry sherry is a measured grape yield plus a vintner's signature.
